index_mode.description: The default index mode for hwloc command-line tools. 'logical' uses indices relative to the topology tree output, 'physical' uses OS-assigned indices.

verbose.description: The default verbosity level for hwloc tools.

default_filter.description: A hwloc location specification string to act as a default filter for tools that support it (e.g., hwloc-calc, hwloc-bind). Empty string means no default filter.
